description: Search the ShelfClub book catalog by title or author name. Returns up to 10 books, each with its ShelfClub id, authors, description, reader rating, series, shelfclub.app link, and mood, vibe, pace and genre tags (machine-generated, or voted for by at least three readers of the book).

query.description: A book title, an author name, or both.

name: search_books

description.description: From the catalog, cut to 600 characters.

id.description: The ShelfClub id of the book.

exactMatch.description: False when nothing matched the query as written and `books` holds the closest titles instead.

retryAfterSeconds.description: With "try_again_later", when known: how long to wait.

status.description: "try_again_later": the service was busy and looked nothing up, so the other fields are absent.

tagProvenance.description: Where the moods, vibes, pace and genres come from.

total.description: How many books in the catalog match, of which `books` is the first few.

title: Search books
